workflow_rule.notes: If an intent is unclear, keep it provisional until the user says done all frame, then compare all rows before final gameplay mapping.

groups.intent: Intro / enter fight / settle into stance

groups.notes: Use after intro callout or before wave start.
Stable readable stance. Return here after actions.
Useful for cinematic/preview turn, not walk.

groups.intent: Alt idle / calm stance / menu preview
groups.notes: Better for preview/menu than active combat.

R02.role: evasive movement, dash burst, dash exit, vanish/teleport candidate
R02.core_theme: High-speed evasive movement and instant displacement
R02.movement_philosophy: This row represents movement beyond readable foot travel. The character should feel like they are bypassing normal locomotion through burst acceleration, vanish movement, and momentum-based recovery.
R02.state_priority: Teleport/vanish states should override normal dodge states if both systems exist.

groups.notes: Looks like a diagonal lift/evade, but final use should wait until all character rows are reviewed. Not punch recovery. Do not wire into gameplay yet.

groups.intent: Ground dash burst into speed trail
groups.notes: Best candidate for dash startup/travel. Do not use as normal run.
Can follow R02-03..R02-06; may also support air movement recovery.
Best candidate for vanish/teleport visual. Keep separate from normal dodge unless design requires vanish dodge.

R03.role: grounded locomotion candidate, combat approach, front-facing hover or power movement candidate
R03.core_theme: Readable body travel and controlled forward movement, with a separate front-facing powered motion group
R03.movement_philosophy: This row contains movement that stays more readable than Row 02. It appears to cover foot-based approach movement first, then a front-facing stance/hover motion that should not be treated as ordinary walking until later comparison.

avoid: direct transition from speed trail without recovery
mixing front-facing hover frames into side walk/run loops
using front-facing hover as normal grounded locomotion

R03.state_priority: If Row 03 walk/run states and Row 02 dash/vanish states compete, Row 02 should own instant displacement while Row 03 should own readable locomotion.

groups.intent: Side walk / measured forward advance candidate
groups.notes: Looks like readable grounded foot travel. Keep provisional until compared with later movement rows.
Strong run/approach candidate with readable body travel. Existing config uses this as run, but final approval should wait for review.

groups.intent: Front-facing hover / power stance motion candidate
groups.notes: Front-facing and stylized. Do not mix into side locomotion. Compare later before assigning gameplay.

gameplay_notes: R03-01..R03-04 can be a slow walk/cautious approach candidate if the loop reads well in gameplay.
R03-05..R03-08 can be a run/combat approach candidate, but should remain separate from Row 02 dash burst.
R03-09..R03-14 should remain provisional. It may be hover, power movement, front-facing cinematic drift, or menu/preview motion.
Row 03 should not be used for hurt, attack recoil, attack recovery, vanish, or dash smear states.
No Row 03 segment should get an attack hitbox by default.
